info.name: E-commerce REST API
info.description:
Based on the sample data from `npm run seed:data` (Electronics tree + 10 products) and the admin from `npm run seed:admin`.
Run the folders top to bottom. Ids and tokens are saved to collection variables by the test scripts. Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` to your admin account.

request.description: Admin created by `npm run seed:admin`. Saves adminToken.
Always creates a customer. Saves customerToken, customerId, customerEmail.
